G3REPEATED20261115.title: Every repeated-line leading ternary cubic is GMC-safe and pure nullity forces a W-linear frame
G3REPEATED20261115.scope: Over C in characteristic zero, every ternary cubic with nonreduced leading homogeneous form L^2*M or L^3 is GMC-safe. Pure nullity forces a nonzero v with B(v,v)=0,grad F3(v)=0,F2(v)=0, hence a Gaussian W-linear frame. For nonisotropic L=u, arbitrary lower terms give P=Y^T A Y+(p*u^2+q*u+r)^T Y+g(u). Exact quadratic elimination gives determinant prefactor det(I-2tA)^(-1/2) and a degree<=4 one-variable phase. The quartic vanishes identically iff p.p=p.A.p=0, which directly supplies the frame. Otherwise the exhaustive invertible, semisimple rank1, nilpotent rank1 and zero matrix split yields full-degree shrinking, an explicit degree-drop escape model, or a fixed quartic with decaying prefactor. For L^3 the cubic coefficient remains nonzero, and all matrix cases exclude pure nullity. For isotropic L=Z, zero W^2 coefficient supplies the frame; with nonzero coefficient the three leading forms Z^2*W+aZ^3,Z^2*T,Z^3 admit exact generic-t W/T quadratic completion and exhaustive stable-degree or degree-drop exclusions. Determinant prefactors never grow, all bounded zero-exponential periods shrink, and escaping actions cannot cancel the stated scalar orders. The written proof imports the retained complete one-variable cut/local-block and rational seed-to-actual-period arguments; no seed cyclicity or Wick convergence is assumed. The checker verifies exact elimination identities and degree/action/count arithmetic, not analytic completeness. Independent replay, external review and formal verification remain outstanding.

G3REDUCEDLEADING20261114.title: Every squarefree-leading ternary cubic is GMC-safe and pure nullity forces a W-linear frame
G3REDUCEDLEADING20261114.scope: Over C in characteristic zero, every ternary cubic of degree3 with squarefree homogeneous leading form satisfies GMC. The exhaustive written plane-cubic cover consists of smooth, irreducible nodal, irreducible cuspidal, transverse/tangent line-smooth-conic, and independent/concurrent distinct-line configurations. The retained theorems and G3LINECONIC20261114 cover every configuration with arbitrary lower terms. GQFINITE20261114.title: Finite quadratic Gaussian classification and sharp mixed cutoff
GQFINITE20261114.scope: For every centered complex quadratic P=X^T A X+l^T X-tr(A) in Gaussian covariance rank N>=1, with A symmetric, the first 2N+1 zero pure moments imply A^N=0 and l^T A^j l=0 for 0<=j<N. Conversely these identities imply all positive pure moments vanish, and E(QP^m)=0 for m>floor(N/2) deg(Q). The local source audits Liu v3 Theorems 2.1 and 2.2 and gives explicit circular chains attaining this mixed bound in every rank N>=2 and every multiplier degree. The optimality of the pure threshold 2N+1 in all ranks is reported separately from Liu and is outside this registered local proof audit. Rank zero is deterministic; rank one admits only the zero moment-null quadratic. The checker verifies finite examples independently, not the universal classification or realization theorem.
dependencies: external: Zongmin Liu, Sharp finite Gaussian moments for quadratic polynomials, Zenodo 21688251 v3

GQ3NORMAL20261114.title: Complete ternary quadratic Gaussian moment-null normal form
GQ3NORMAL20261114.scope: Every complex polynomial of degree at most two in three standard real Gaussian variables with all positive pure moments zero has, in a complex orthogonal circular frame, the form P=Z*(a*Z+b*T+c), with E(ZW)=E(T^2)=1 and the other pairings zero. Conversely all such forms are moment-null and satisfy E(QP^m)=0 for m>deg(Q). The proof uses the dimension-one isotropic Krylov space and the rank-one or Jordan-(3) self-adjoint nilpotent cases; complex orthogonal invariance is invariance of the Wick functional. Equality is attained by P=Z,Q=W^d at m=d. This closes the quadratic layer only and does not exclude dense cubic failures or settle ordinary-Laplacian lifting.

G3HEIGHT20261114.title: Complete cubic-height Gaussian classification via formal Airy--Riccati obstruction
G3HEIGHT20261114.scope: For P=W*h(Z)+s(Z)*T^3+v(Z)*T^2+u(Z)*T+r(Z) with arbitrary complex univariate polynomial coefficients and E(ZW)=E(T^2)=1, all positive pure moments zero force s=0 whenever h(0)!=0. The preceding complete affine-W classification then applies. On h(0)=0, pure vanishing is equivalent to h divisible by Z^2 and s,v,u,r divisible by Z, giving strictly one-sided support and GMC safety. In particular the entire thirteen-coefficient cubic family has s=0 on its pure-null locus and contains no GMC failure. In quartic degree the extended family has eighteen coefficients; its failures are precisely the preceding linear-h, linear-repair family with s=0. The proof derives a formal cubic-Gaussian two-by-two differential system, proves that rational logarithmic derivative would give an algebraic Airy Riccati solution, and excludes algebraic solutions by finite-point ODE uniqueness, Riemann--Hurwitz and rational behavior at infinity. It does not use a singular change of integration contour. The checker proves the universal rational identities and separately tests finite Wick regressions; formalization and external review remain absent. No general ternary frame reduction is claimed.

G3AFFINEW20261114.title: All-degree affine-W ternary Gaussian pure-moment classification
G3AFFINEW20261114.scope: For P=W*h(Z)+v(Z)*T^2+u(Z)*T+r(Z) with arbitrary complex univariate polynomial coefficients and circular Wick pairings E(ZW)=E(T^2)=1, all positive pure moments vanish exactly in three branches. If h(0)=0, h is divisible by Z^2 and v,u,r by Z, giving strictly one-sided support and GMC safety. If h=a!=0 is constant, v=0 and r=-Z*u^2/(2a), giving a polynomial Gaussian triangular shear and GMC safety. If h=a+bZ with a*b!=0, v=(h-h^3/a^2)/(2Z), u=h^2*k and r=-(a^2/2)*Z*h*k^2 for an arbitrary polynomial k; then E(Z*P^m)=m!*a*b^(m-1) for every m>=1, so every member fails GMC. No higher-degree h with nonzero constant term is possible: its reduced logarithmic-derivative numerator has a root off h, contradicting the forced polynomial square identity. The proof uses GL1 and rational-exponential rigidity; exact finite regressions test both charts and nonconstant repaired failures, not the universal quantifiers. No global ternary classification or novelty claim.
